## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7ba013288b8216e40ea3eeaacb9066f691f399b8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md + packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts (`ObjectExtensionSchema.fieldPatches`, `defineObjectExtension`), packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts (`BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST`), packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`patchedField`, `mergeObjectDefinitions`, contributor sort), packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts (step 2e), packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts (step 3a-v), content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx, .changeset/28565-field-patch-applied.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/indexing.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md, examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts, packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs. Read on `origin/main` at review time (the merge base plus six commits, none of which touches the cited fieldPatches code; the install-door file shifted by six lines on an unrelated gate, so the dev's line numbers read six lower than main's). The remainder of the diff, `.changeset/28730-skill-field-patches.md`, is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; ② reads it only for the level.

Reviewed at 2026-11-01T20:29Z. Inputs: card #28730 body and its four comments, PR #28795 body, file list and net diff against the merge base, the check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Governed path, whole PR.** `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` is a register row, so the landing is Tier H for both files (one path hit is enough); the PR is draft with `mergeable_state: blocked` and no approving review, which is the right state until an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approves. Right.
- **Public surface moved: the published skill text only.** `@objectstack/skills` ships `skills/**` whole into `dist/` (`sync-catalog.mjs` wipe-then-copy, read back and compared), so the new paragraph and the three deletions are a change to a published package's content and nothing else: no schema, runtime, CLI, `content/docs/**`, eval or ratchet-script change. The facts the three deleted blocks carried stay in the same published bundle (`rules/indexing.md`, `rules/validation.md`, and the folded sentence at SKILL.md L125-126). Right.
- **Token ratchet: paid, no ceiling moved.** `CEILINGS` row for the file is 6123 (ratchet script L513); the head reads 6111 per the PR body and the ratchet runs green in CI (Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates: success). The 2026-10-27 ruling is quoted in the body for the record but is not spent, since no row moves. Right.
- **Gate families CI answered on the head:** Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · CI release & engine gates, the three scoped lints, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Build Core, Type Check · workspace / source gates / debt ledger, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate: success. Test Core shards and Type Check · consumer gates finished last: at the final read, 41 check-runs on the head, none pending, none failed (success or path-skipped: UI, docs build, dogfood shards, temporal, opt-in harnesses). The conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was run locally. Right.
- **No eval added.** The diff implies no change to the accept set of the `objectstack-data` evals; neither fixture mentions object extensions (`git grep` over `skills/objectstack-data/evals`: no hit). Right as an accept-set judgment; carried as a boundary flag under ③.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/28730-skill-field-patches.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. The package publishes the skill tree from `dist/` (`files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`, build = `sync-catalog.mjs`), so a teaching-text change is a patch of that package and of no other: no package's code, schema or `.describe()` moves. Level matches what the diff publishes. Check Changeset: success.

Clause-②: `no` on the PR body and on the changeset, and the diff narrows nothing: the fold, the install door and `os validate` are untouched; the skill only teaches what they already do. Matches. `Metadata-protocol: none` matches too (no metadata key, shape or semantic moves).

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 6563288115 (facts, deviations, out-of-scope), card comment 6563093521 (PM), and the card's eval scenario, each answered:

- **Facts table, eight rows.** Each read in the live code and found as cited. `fields` takeover: `registry.ts` `merged.fields = { ...base.fields, ...extension.fields }`; mdx L98-100. Display keys: `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST.field` = label, description, inlineHelpText, placeholder; `.option` = label; the slot's `.describe()` says the same. Option addressed by stored `value`: `patchedField` `hasOwnProperty(optionPatches, option.value)`; `extension-field-patch-targets.ts` L130-136. Owner keeps type, values, rules: `field-customization.ts` L65-68. Tenant edit wins: `tenantPatched` yield per key in `patchedField` (field key and option key). Higher `priority` wins: contributors sorted ascending, the higher one written last. Missing field / option refused: `fieldPatchTargetMisses` reasons `field` and `option`; install door step 2e answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `details.refusals`; `os validate` step 3a-v reports the same judge's refusals (JSON: `valid: false`, exit 1). Picklist-bound: reason `picklist-option` at both doors, and `patchedField` skips `options` when `field.picklist` is set. Answered: all hold.
- **Deviation 1** (relay `pr_create` run detached, exit code not captured): the PR exists at the reviewed head with the body the report describes; no bearing on the tree. Answered.
- **Deviation 2** (first lint build mis-invoked, superseded by the whole-repo build): the branch is one commit and the net diff is the two listed files; nothing else changed. Answered.
- **Deviation 3** (no details/summary folding in the PR body): a format choice that keeps angle brackets out of GitHub text; nothing owed. Answered.
- **Deviation 4** (worktree left for patch rounds): seat housekeeping, not a review matter. Answered.
- **`open_questions: []`**: none raised; none found that the dev should have raised, except the PM comment below.
- **Out-of-scope finding (no eval exercises object extensions)**: confirmed (`evals/*.json`: no `objectExtensions` / `fieldPatches`). The card's Wanted names one paragraph, so no eval is owed on this PR; under ruling 6513306068 letter B an eval fixture is measured, not ratcheted, so one costs no ceiling. Escalated to the seat as a follow-up card: an `objectstack-data` eval whose prompt is the card's Reach line ("Sector" instead of "Industry" on a vendor field) and whose accept set requires `fieldPatches` and refuses a redeclared `industry` in `fields`.
- **PM comment 6563093521 (not answered in the dev report)**: it asks the paragraph to teach, "once PR #28791 lands", that a patch reaches the owner's own fields only. PR #28791 is open and unmerged at review time; on `main` the fold still applies a patch after the additive merges so it reaches a field a lower-priority extension added (`mergeObjectDefinitions` comment; mdx L126-128), and the install door's target is the registry's resolved object. The head's paragraph neither claims nor denies that reach, so it is true on `main` today and stays true after #28791; writing the PM's sentence now would teach a refusal `main` does not make. Escalated, not a fix on this PR: when #28791 merges, its `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line owes this section one sentence ("a patch reaches the owner's own fields only; set an added field's text where it is declared"), at a cost the 12-token headroom will not cover without one more deletion.
- **Card eval scenario (Reach line)**: judged under ④, first bullet.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, against the card's scenario (an AI author working from this skill wants a vendor field to read "Sector" instead of "Industry") and the spec it teaches on `main`:

- **Leads the author to `fieldPatches`.** The new paragraph opens the section's second block in bold with the exact choice the scenario poses: relabel with `fieldPatches`, never by redeclaring in `fields`, and says why (takeover, cut off from upgrades). An author who reads the section reaches the right key; the one-line example is the shape the author must emit. Holds.
- **Every taught claim holds against the live code** (the eight facts under ③). The one simplification is "refused ... by `os validate`" without "when the target is in the composed stack" (`fieldPatchTargetRefusals` judges nothing when `getTarget` does not know the target); the spec's own `.describe()` makes the same simplification, and the install door is the backstop, so this is an observation, not a finding.
- **The three deletions lose no taught fact.** Search Fields: the lint code `searchable-field-unknown` and `400 INVALID_FIELD` are folded into L125-126; "the mirror field is the answer" is L128's "This is the one prescription". Index Patterns: `rules/indexing.md` L26-33 carries the protocol-17 retirement, the `tsc` / parse error and `os migrate meta --from 16`; L63-77 carries bare `unique: true` refused on a declared index and meaning `'organization'` on a FIELD; the new pointer names the retired keys and the scope words. Validation Patterns: `rules/validation.md` L15-22 carries each type's gloss; the six names stay on one line. `rules/**` ships in the same `dist/`. Holds.
- **Rule and gate: n/a.** The diff adds no rule a gate enforces and moves no gate.

Findings:

- **should-fix** — The example's option key `tech` names an option the reference `crm_account.industry` does not have: `examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts` (and app-showcase) store `technology`, `finance`, `healthcare`, `retail`, `other`. An author who copies the example against the reference CRM is refused at `os validate` / install with reason `option` (the message lists the real values, so it fails loud, hence not must-fix), and the relabel `tech` to "Technology" is the label that value already has. The key is inherited from the mdx and the #28565 changeset, which the card named as the source, but the skill is the surface an author copies from: key the option by a stored value the reference app declares (e.g. `options: { technology: { label: 'Tech' } }`), or drop the `options` clause from the one-line example and keep "keyed by its stored `value`" as prose.
- **should-fix** — The section's first sentence still spells the helper as `defineObjectExtension({ extend, fields, priority })`, so an author who stops at the signature sees no `fieldPatches` key. Add it to that spelled shape (`{ extend, fields, fieldPatches, priority }`), about four tokens inside the 12-token headroom.

No must-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-28730-field-patches-skill`
Reviewed-by: `session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cbd8528c5b64fcdf46d8a1a84f261bc419c12b5f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md + examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts (`crm_account.industry`, the example's target), packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts (`ObjectExtensionSchema`, `defineObjectExtension`), packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts (the option check the old key tripped), packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`patchedField`, `mergeObjectDefinitions`), and the round-1 cited set re-checked for movement on `origin/main`. The remainder of the diff, `.changeset/28730-skill-field-patches.md` (unchanged this round), is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

Delta round on record 6563471541 (head one commit earlier), reviewed at 2026-11-01T20:50Z. Inputs: card #28730 body and five comments (delta report 6563616611 included), PR #28795 body, file list, the delta diff between the two heads and the net diff against the merge base, the check-runs on this head. `main` has moved one commit past the previous round (registry: a refused package leaves nothing registered); it touches none of `patchedField`, `mergeObjectDefinitions`, the contributor sort, the target check, the whitelist, the two doors, the mdx or the reference CRM. PR #28791 is still open and unmerged.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The delta is two line edits in the one `hits` file**, both inside the Object Extension Model section: the spelled signature gains `fieldPatches`; the example's option key becomes `technology` with label `'Tech'`. The net diff against the merge base is still the same two files; the changeset is byte-identical to round 1. No accept set, schema, runtime, doc or eval surface moves beyond the published skill text. Right.
- **Governed path, whole PR**: unchanged, Tier H, draft, no approving review. Right.
- **Token ratchet**: the delta is +14 bytes for `, fieldPatches` and byte-neutral on the option rename (+6 / −6), so the file moves from 6111 to 6114 against the 6123 ceiling (headroom 9); no row moves and the ratchet gate runs green in CI. Right.
- **Check-runs on this head**: 41 at the final read, none pending, none failed; success on Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · ESLint, Lint · CI release & engine gates, the three scoped lints, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Build Core, every Type Check leg, the Test Core shards, Test UI, Live E2E UI and the Dogfood Regression Gate; the rest path-skipped (UI, docs build, dogfood shards, temporal, opt-in harnesses). The conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was run locally. Right.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from round 1 and still right: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` for a teaching-text change in the package that ships `skills/**` from `dist/`; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on body and changeset match a diff that narrows no capability and moves no metadata key. Check Changeset: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Should-fix 1 (example option key)** — resolved. `examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts` on `origin/main` declares `name: 'crm_account'` and `industry: Field.select({ options: [...] })` with stored values `technology`, `finance`, `healthcare`, `retail`, `other` and no `picklist` binding, so `options: { technology: { label: 'Tech' } }` names an option `fieldPatchTargetMisses` finds (reason `option` no longer fires; `picklist-option` cannot), and `patchedField` writes the label onto that option. The relabel is now a real change ("Technology" to "Tech"), so the example demonstrates the key instead of restating a label.
- **Should-fix 2 (spelled signature)** — resolved. The section's first sentence reads `defineObjectExtension({ extend, fields, fieldPatches, priority })`; every key named is one `ObjectExtensionSchema` declares (`extend`, `fields`, `fieldPatches`, `priority`), and the order matches the schema's.
- **Delta report 6563616611**: `deviations: []`, `open_questions: []`; `files_changed` matches the delta diff (SKILL.md only); the line budget it states matches the byte arithmetic above. The `read_only_answer` and the out-of-scope finding (the `tech` key in the mdx, the #28565 changeset and the slot's `.describe()` / TSDoc) are the seat's to file, per its own note; not re-flagged here.
- **Round-1 escalations** (the eval follow-up; the one sentence owed when PR #28791 merges) stand as recorded and are the seat's; nothing on this head changes them. The PR body still quotes the round-1 reading (6111 / headroom 12); the tree is judged, not the body, and the body is the dev's single write.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` against the card's scenario and the spec on `main`:

- The section now names `fieldPatches` at both reads an author makes: the signature line (the skim) and the bold paragraph (the rule). An author wanting "Sector" for "Industry" reaches `fieldPatches` from either. Holds.
- The example is now installable against the reference CRM as written: `extend: 'crm_account'` exists, `industry` is one of its own fields, `technology` is one of that field's stored values, and `label` is the one option key the whitelist admits. Every other claim in the paragraph is unchanged from round 1 and still reads true in the live code. Holds.
- Tried to break it: an author who copies the example into a stack that also redeclares `industry` in `fields` still gets the takeover the paragraph warns against, but the paragraph's first sentence forbids exactly that; an author who writes `options: { Technology: ... }` (the label, not the value) is refused with the real values listed. Nothing on this head misleads.

No must-fix. No should-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-28730-field-patches-skill`
Reviewed-by: `session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc`

**VERDICT: PASS**

domain:skills#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc

## 维护者速读(席位终稿 · head `cbd8528c5b64fcdf46d8a1a84f261bc419c12b5f`)

- **改了什么**:对外发布的 `objectstack-data` skill 在〈Object Extension Model〉加一段讲 `fieldPatches`。它说明只能改哪些显示项(标签、说明、帮助文字、占位符、按存储值的选项标签),类型、取值和规则仍归字段所有者;租户自己的修改优先,扩展之间 `priority` 高的优先;指向不存在的字段或选项会在安装和 `os validate` 时被拒;绑定 picklist 的字段的选项不能改。附一个 `crm_account.industry` → "Sector" 的例子。
- **为什么改**:#28565 让 `fieldPatches` 生效了,但 skill 只教 `fields`/`priority`。AI 作者想把厂商字段 "Industry" 显示成 "Sector" 时,会在 `fields` 里重新声明这个字段,结果把整个字段接管了。
- **风险与回滚**:只改 skill 文本,外加一个 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。为腾出 token 预算删了三段重复内容,原文都还在 `rules/indexing.md`、`rules/validation.md` 和同文件其他段落里(复审已逐条核对)。回滚 = revert。
- **先看**:`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 〈Object Extension Model〉。
- **两分钟验证**:例子里的 `technology` 是 `examples/app-crm` 中 `crm_account.industry` 真实存在的存储值;`check-skills-token-ratchet` 6114/6123,通过。
- **需要你做的**:批准本 PR(`skills/**` 对外发布,以你的批准为裁决)。契约复审 PASS:6563706246(`Head-sha: cbd8528c5b64fcdf46d8a1a84f261bc419c12b5f`)。

**席位意见:ACCEPT.**

## 席位核对

- **形态:** 2 files: `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (472 → 468 lines, 6101 → 6114 tokens vs ceiling 6123, no ceiling moved) and `.changeset/28730-skill-field-patches.md` (`@objectstack/skills: patch`). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **执行档:** the dev ran at the tier `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates for `skills/**` (clause ①, no one-line exit). The reviewer was a separate agent.
- **复审:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS 6563471541 (head `7ba013288b`, 0 must-fix, 2 should-fix) → patch round (delta report 6563616611) → delta PASS 6563706246 on `cbd8528c5b64fcdf46d8a1a84f261bc419c12b5f`, 0 must-fix, 0 should-fix. The review checked every fact in the paragraph against the code at the file:line the dev cited, and checked that each of the three deleted blocks still has a live home.
- **门禁:** dev's `dispatch-gates --commands` 45/45 exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED, both rounds. Check-runs on `cbd8528c`: 41, 0 pending, 0 failed (record 6563706246).
- **接受的偏差:** the dev ran the relay `pr_create` detached, so the waiting shell did not capture its exit code. The PR exists, and its body read back identical (record ③). PR footer is the 🤖 form; no PR assignee — as on #28739.
- **范围外去向:**
  - Spec `.describe()`/TSDoc and `object-extensions.mdx` carry the same non-existent `tech` option key: filed #28803.
  - No eval exercises object extensions: filed #28804, blocked by #28730.
  - When PR #28791 merges, its `Skills-docs:` follow-up owes this section one sentence (record 6563471541 ③). It is noted here and belongs to #28791's own checklist.
- **落地条款:** Tier H by the card, `skills/**` governed. The PR stays draft with `needs-user-decision` until an authorised approver acts; then the seat clears the label, flips ready and enqueues.
